answer: Persistent co-presence ledger. Each identity must maintain a continuously witnessed public presence — periodic signed check-ins countersigned by three geographically clustered peers, with the roster rotated through a nebula of regional relays to prevent collusion. New identities get a probationary terrace: low-value actions only, until 90 days of unbroken co-presence accrue, and any lapse resets the clock. Every sybil must therefore fund 90 days of real infrastructure and human upkeep per fake identity, making farm scale brutal; an island of puppets collapses the moment one misses a check-in.
